_doc: Parallel test-time scaling example. Uses Gemini 3.7 Flash (Medium) for every rollout, verifier, and synthesis step. Requires route gemini37_flash_medium enabled in config/swarm_router.local.json (the open-source base keeps it disabled). Candidates run in isolated git worktrees; verify commands execute inside each worktree and the winner's diff is applied back to the workspace.
goal: Implement the reshard utility pair with parallel candidate rollouts, deterministic verification, and Gemini 3.7 Medium synthesis.

tasks.task: Implement bench_apps/reshard/compress.py. It must copy an input directory into shard_N folders under an output directory, with at most 3 files per shard and no writes outside the output directory.
acceptance: no writes outside the output directory

tasks.task: Implement bench_apps/reshard/decompress.py. It must reconstruct the original flat files from a resharded directory into a target directory, preserving file contents.
acceptance: path traversal outside the output is refused

tasks.task: Create bench_tests/test_bench_reshard.py with roundtrip tests, output-boundary checks, and deterministic shard naming. Do not edit bench_apps/.
